# GNU Unifont 16px

Used for the 16 px LCD interface font (`common/src/ak_font_ui16_data.c`) and one entry
of the font test page (`common/src/ak_font_data.c`).

- Version: 18.0.01, <https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/unifont/unifont-18.0.01/>
- Source file: `unifont-18.0.01.otf`, sha256
  `88d0a14d4aa9a96419720b39ba5da921a59560d76d4ec7d523acc06ed85cd3c2`
  (not stored in this repository)
- Copyright (C) 1998-2026 Roman Czyborra, Paul Hardy, Qianqian Fang, et al.
- Licence: the compiled fonts are dual-licensed under the SIL Open Font
  License 1.1, or GPLv2+ with the GNU font embedding exception. **Ki-board
  uses them under the SIL OFL 1.1.** `LICENSE.txt` is the upstream licence
  file, with both texts.
- The firmware embeds a subset, which the OFL treats as a Modified Version.
  Unifont declares no Reserved Font Name, so the subset may keep the name.
